summary: A load-failure state with a wifi-off icon and Retry plus Contact support buttons.
use: Network or fetch errors on a data panel where the user can retry or escalate.
spec: `<EmptyState icon={WifiOff} title="Couldn't load data" description="Check your connection and try again.">`
`{#snippet actions()}` holds `<Button variant="outlined" size="sm">Retry</Button>` and `<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Contact support</Button>`
